en.headline: Hang Seng slips 20 points at the midday close
en.dek: The index finished the morning at 23,952 after touching 24,005, with main-board turnover near HK$54.6 billion, RTHK reported.
body: Hong Kong stocks traded in a narrow range on Monday morning, the first session of October after the holiday. The Hang Seng Index closed the morning at 23,952, down 20 points, after rising as high as 24,005, RTHK reported. Main-board turnover was about HK$54.6 billion.

Property shares were weaker, with the sector index down nearly 1 per cent. Longfor and Henderson Land fell nearly 2 per cent, while Sun Hung Kai Properties and CK Asset were down more than 1 per cent. Heavyweight financials also slipped, with HSBC and AIA each down more than 1 per cent.

The Hang Seng Tech Index was steadier, up nearly 0.3 per cent at 4,169. Alibaba rose nearly 1 per cent while Xiaomi fell nearly 2 per cent. RTHK said some artificial-intelligence and chip names were firmer, with Zhipu and Lenovo up nearly 5 per cent, and Hua Hong Semiconductor and Iluvatar CoreX up about 4 per cent or more.

zh.headline: 恒指半日收市跌20點 報23952點
zh.dek: 港台報道，恒指早段曾高見24005點，中午收報23952點，半日主板成交額近546億元。
body: 港股星期一假期後復市，早段在24000點附近窄幅上落。香港電台報道，恒生指數一度高見24005點，中午收市報23952點，跌20點，半日主板成交額近546億元。
地產分類指數跌近1%。龍湖集團和恒基地產跌近2%，新鴻基地產和長實集團跌逾1%。重磅金融股亦向下，匯豐控股和友邦保險各跌逾1%。
恒生科技指數相對靠穩，半日報4169點，升近0.3%。阿里巴巴升近1%，小米跌近2%。港台說，部分人工智能及晶片股造好，智譜和聯想集團升近半成，華虹宏力和天數智芯升近4%或以上。
